The '''Vryssa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dalicron sector/Legends|Dalicron sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vryssa]].
